name: tells-lays-a-page-under-the-kind
query: :Guide |~~ A guide. ~~| (::kind | tells :start |~~ Where to start. ~~| #[::vec]) | get [~(::Guide/start | doc | content | trim) ~(::Guide/start | binding | get /value)]

name: proves-writes-a-law-of-the-kind
query: :Guide |~~ A guide. ~~| (::kind | proves :holds |~~ It holds. ~~| ~(true)) | ::Guide | runLaws | map /ok

name: carries-writes-a-fact-of-a-refusal-of-the-kind
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~| (::kind | throws :TooWideError |~~ Too wide. ~~| | carries :TooWideError/w |~~ The width refused. ~~| ::number) | ::Box/TooWideError/w | binding | get /value

name: a-name-of-a-kind-is-declared-once
query: ::kind | reads :w |~~ The width. ~~| /w | tells :w |~~ A page. ~~| !| type

name: an-invariant-with-a-path-names-a-field-read-before-it
query: ::kind | holds :w/NegativeError |~~ No width below zero. ~~| ~(gte 0) !| type

name: a-fact-of-no-kinds-holds-its-page
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~| (::kind | throws :TooWideError |~~ Too wide. ~~| | carries :TooWideError/note |~~ A note. ~~|) | ::Box/TooWideError/note | binding | get /value | type

name: a-kind-takes-no-constructor-but-the-hosts
query: get [~(::kind | impl ~(get {:s ~(it)}) !| type) ~(::kind | impl 5 !| type) ~(::kind[~() 5] !| type)]

name: the-literal-of-a-kind-reads-back
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~| ::kind[~(wraps |~~ The sizes. ~~| ::map) null] | ::Box"x" !| type

name: a-constructor-handed-with-another-kind-constructs-nothing-under-this-one
query: :B |~~ B. ~~| (::kind | impl (::number/construct | binding | get /value)) | get [~(::B"x" | type) ~(::B"x" | payload)]
